title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Ising Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2603.00408v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present an Ising-compatible framework for formal neural-network robustness verification under bounded input perturbations. For piecewise activations (both continuous piecewise-linear and discrete piecewise-constant), the Exact Logarithmic Piecewise Model (Log-PW) provides an exact, sound, and complete formulation with a state-optimal logarithmic encoding, reducing the binary variables per neuron from linear $O(\kappa)$ to information-theoretically minimal logarithmic complexity $O(\lceil \log_2 \kappa \rceil)$ via logarithmic SOS2 (Log-PWL) and SOS1 (Log-PWC) constraints. For general element-wise activations, the Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env) leverages Log-PWC to construct sound, refinable endpoint enclosures. An exact monotonic reduction based on Jordan decomposition further extends this framework to arbitrary non-monotonic activations. We further develop a hybrid Benders solver with output-sensitive iteration bounds,

translated_title: 基于Ising求解器的神经网络精确且渐近完备的鲁棒性验证
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个与Ising求解器兼容的形式化神经网络鲁棒性验证框架，用于处理有界输入扰动下的验证问题。对于分段激活函数（包括连续分段线性和离散分段常数激活函数），精确对数分段模型（Log-PW）提供了一个精确、可靠且完备的表述，采用状态最优的对数编码，通过对数SOS2（Log-PWL）和SOS1（Log-PWC）约束，将每个神经元的二元变量数量从线性复杂度O(κ)降低到信息论意义上最小的对数复杂度O(⌈log₂κ⌉)。对于一般的逐元素激活函数，渐近阶梯包络模型（Step-Env）利用Log-PWC构建可靠且可不断精化的端点包络。基于Jordan分解的精确单调化简方法进一步将该框架扩展到任意非单调激活函数。我们进一步开发了具有输出敏感迭代界的混合Benders求解器。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个与Ising求解器兼容的神经网络鲁棒性验证框架，通过对数编码（Log-PW）将每个神经元的二元变量复杂度从线性降至对数级别，并结合基于Jordan分解的单调化简与混合Benders求解器，实现了对包括非单调激活在内的各类激活函数的精确且渐近完备的鲁棒性验证。
